metaTitle: Brewing Buddha Case Study: 40M Views | Button Up Media
metaDescription: How Button Up Media made short videos for Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse in Pinecrest, a quirky coffee shop and art space, that reached 40M organic views.
ldHeadline: Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse: 40M organic social views for a Pinecrest coffee shop
h1Sub: 40M organic views for a Pinecrest cafe
answer: Brewing Buddha Cafe & Arthouse is a quirky coffee shop and art space in Pinecrest. Our short videos about its creative lattes reached 40M organic views.

hero.alt: Guests at Brewing Buddha talk about the cafe in a short social video

card.alt: Jordan Athos, owner of Brewing Buddha
card.label: organic views

metrics.label: Organic social views
metrics.meaning: Unpaid views. People found and watched these videos on their own, with no ad money pushing them.

metrics.label: Standout: the butter coffee video
metrics.meaning: One signature drink, shot up close, became a standout for the account. Often one menu item is all a video needs.

metrics.label: Owner video testimonial
metrics.meaning: Owner Jordan Athos went on camera to talk about working with us. You can watch it further down this page.

paragraphs: Brewing Buddha is a quirky coffee shop and art space known for its creative lattes.
Generic coffee content would have hidden exactly what makes it different. In owner Jordan Athos's words, they needed somebody to match their energy.

items.title: Film what people come for
items.bodyHtml: Short videos built around the creative lattes and the art space.

items.title: Trade ideas both ways
items.bodyHtml: We pitch, they pitch, and the strongest concepts make the feed.

items.title: Let one drink lead
items.bodyHtml: Our February 2025 video on their butter coffee became a standout.

quote.text: They bring creative ideas, they're not afraid to push the lines, we needed somebody to match our energy, we bounce off ideas and work as a team.
quote.name: Jordan Athos
